name: Custom Promotional Branding
old_description: Search through hundreds of promotional items to fit any theme or budget.
about:
Custom Promotional Branding operates from Jefferson City, Missouri. The company describes itself as a locally owned and operated business that is community involved. No founding year or founders are disclosed in the available information.

The company supplies a wide range of promotional items including wearables, headwear, pens, pet bandanas, umbrellas, and tape measures. It offers custom branding services, in-person consultations, and virtual samples. Details about facility size, headcount, or order volumes are not publicly provided.

Its customer base spans sports organizations, banking institutions, technology companies, and general corporate merchandise buyers. The company highlights showrooms for sports, banking, and technology sectors.

The company emphasizes personalized service, offering in-person consultations and a community-focused approach. It states its aim is to give clients the best customer service available.
type_evidence: Custom Promotional Branding is a community involved, locally owned and operated business that aims to give its clients the best customer service available.
